## Two lives, one axis

**Anne Frank** (1929–1945) and **Martin Luther King Jr.** (1929–1968) were both born in 1929. The cards below put them on a single time axis, so the overlap is visible rather than asserted — and so is the silence afterwards.

Every event here is a **structured Wikidata statement**: birth, death, education, posts, awards, residences. There is no date in Wikidata for the diary, the arrest, or the March on Washington — that is what the article prose holds. See `docs/LIFELINE-WIDGET.md`.
